name: Basecamp
description: Basecamp lets agents read projects and message threads, add to-dos, and post updates with the access the signed-in user already has. Each user signs in to their own Basecamp account through the browser.

prompts.text: Catch me up on the website redesign project this week.
Which to-dos assigned to me are overdue?
Add a to-do to review the launch checklist by Thursday.

apps.name: Basecamp
apps.description: Project, to-do, and message tools, over Basecamp's MCP server with browser sign-in.
